given `surf.document.Check` input, decide and enact exactly one outcome. Declared outcomes (declaration order, not selection precedence): `no-such-element` for an identity no record carries, error `surf.document.ElementNotFound`; `not-checkable` when the existing subject's stored fields satisfy `(kind != checkbox and kind != radio)`, error `surf.document.ControlKindConflict`; `disabled` when the existing subject's stored fields satisfy `disabled == true`, error `surf.document.ControlDisabled`; `hidden` when the existing subject's stored fields satisfy `hidden == true`, error `surf.document.ControlHidden`; `radio-checked` when the existing subject's stored fields satisfy `kind == radio`, updates `surf.document.Element`, changes, beside its subject, every `surf.document.Element` where `(kind == radio and document_id == subject.document_id and radio_group == subject.radio_group)`, setting `checked`, emits `surf.document.CheckednessSet`; `unchecked` when the existing subject's stored fields satisfy `checked == true`, updates `surf.document.Element`, emits `surf.document.CheckednessSet`; `checked` otherwise, updates `surf.document.Element`, emits `surf.document.CheckednessSet`

given `surf.document.SelectOption` input, decide and enact exactly one outcome. Declared outcomes (declaration order, not selection precedence): `no-such-option` for an identity no record carries, error `surf.document.OptionNotFound`; `disabled` when the existing subject's stored fields satisfy `disabled == true`, error `surf.document.ControlDisabled`; `hidden` when the existing subject's stored fields satisfy `hidden == true`, error `surf.document.ControlHidden`; `selected` otherwise, updates `surf.document.Option`, changes, beside its subject, every `surf.document.Option` where `select_id == subject.select_id`, setting `selected`, emits `surf.document.OptionSelected`

given `surf.navigation.CommitNavigation` input, decide and enact exactly one outcome. Declared outcomes (declaration order, not selection precedence): `no-such-navigation` for an identity no record carries, error `surf.navigation.NavigationNotFound`; `traversed` when the existing subject's stored fields satisfy `handling == traverse`, takes `commit` of `surf.navigation.Navigation`, changes, beside its subject, every `surf.navigation.Navigation` where `(tab_id == subject.tab_id and standing == back)`, setting `standing`, changes, beside its subject, every `surf.navigation.Navigation` where `(tab_id == subject.tab_id and standing == forward)`, setting `standing`, changes, beside its subject, every `surf.navigation.Navigation` where `(tab_id == subject.tab_id and standing == current)`, setting `standing`, changes, beside its subject, every `surf.navigation.Navigation` where `(tab_id == subject.tab_id and next == subject.entry_id)`, setting `standing`, changes, beside its subject, every `surf.navigation.Navigation` where `(tab_id == subject.tab_id and navigation_id == subject.entry_next)`, setting `standing`, changes, beside its subject, every `surf.navigation.Navigation` where `(tab_id == subject.tab_id and navigation_id == subject.entry_id)`, setting `standing`, emits `surf.navigation.NavigationCommitted`; `committed` otherwise, takes `commit` of `surf.navigation.Navigation`, changes, beside its subject, every `surf.navigation.Navigation` where `(tab_id == subject.tab_id and (standing == forward or standing == later))`, setting `standing`, changes, beside its subject, every `surf.navigation.Navigation` where `(tab_id == subject.tab_id and standing == back)`, setting `standing`, changes, beside its subject, every `surf.navigation.Navigation` where `(tab_id == subject.tab_id and standing == current)`, setting `standing`, `next`, changes, beside its subject, every `surf.navigation.Navigation` where `(tab_id == subject.tab_id and handling == traverse and state == Started)`, moving it along `cancel` (a row resting outside its `from` states is left as it is), emits `surf.navigation.NavigationCommitted`; `wrong-state` from a state no declared move starts in, error `surf.navigation.NavigationStateConflict`

disposition.contract: given `surf.navigation.TraverseHistory` input, decide and enact exactly one outcome. Declared outcomes (declaration order, not selection precedence): `unsupported` when `(step != back and step != forward)`, error `surf.navigation.TraversalUnsupported`; `no-entry` when, of the `surf.navigation.Navigation` rows satisfying `(tab_id == input.tab_id and defined(standing) and standing == input.step and method == Get)`, no row is selected, error `surf.navigation.NoHistoryEntry`; `requested` otherwise, emits `surf.navigation.TraversalStarted`
